subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should Telegram SOCKS/proxy reliability be fixed now by a shared scheme-aware proxy transport change, or should this remain blocked on additional live reproduction and product direction?
rationale: The implicated path is compatibility-sensitive shared proxy transport behavior, and the open candidate PR changes only part of the supported proxy surface without sufficient live proof.

options.title: Replace With Shared Proxy Repair
options.body: Prefer a focused shared proxy fix that covers explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS modes, preserves existing HTTP proxy defaults, and includes live Telegram or equivalent proxy proof.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open but do not change proxy behavior until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main SOCKS5 getMe/sendMessage diagnostics.

options.title: Use Existing Workarounds
options.body: Treat current Telegram network config and proxy guidance as the supported answer for now, leaving any new proxy behavior change to a later maintainer-sponsored item.

recommendation.title: Replace With Shared Proxy Repair
recommendation.body: Prefer a focused shared proxy fix that covers explicit and env SOCKS/HTTP/HTTPS modes, preserves existing HTTP proxy defaults, and includes live Telegram or equivalent proxy proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The main unresolved choice crosses the shared Undici proxy helper and Telegram transport behavior where steipete has the strongest current history signal.
